about: M2.2: coco_lab split into Python packs the Arena worker loads lazily. 'core' (coco_lab.zip, every module not listed below) is what the Plan lens needs and loads at boot; a lens's pack loads the first time the lens is selected. build_arena_assets.mjs refuses a module in two packs, and an import that crosses packs except into core or into a pack listed in 'requires'.
